Paper title: "A self-supervised electrocardiogram foundation model for empowering cardiovascular disease prediction and genetic factor discovery"

Facts:
- ECG-LFM: self-supervised Electrocardiogram Large-scale Foundation Model, pre-trained over ten million 12-lead ECGs from multiple ECG datasets.
- Integrates contrastive learning with masked language modeling; multi-segment contrastive loss.
- Fine-tuned to predict eight types of CVDs; average AUROC 0.930 from multiple datasets.
- EDFs represent known CVD biomarkers.
- GWAS identified 24 significant SNPs (P-value < 5×10-8, LD r2 < 0.01) associated with ECG, including 8 novel findings.
- Mendelian randomization: 2 CVDs and 4 EDFs having causal relationships.
- Pre-training: 11,571,587 12-lead ECG records from HEEDB and MIMIC-IV-ECG (page 3 Fig 1B says 11,571,587; page 11 says 11,571,587 records of 1,979,599 individuals). HEEDB 10,608,417 records of 1,818,247 individuals; MIMIC-IV-ECG 800,035 records of 161,352 individuals.
- Five task-specific datasets: PTB-XL, Chapman, CODE-15, CPSC-2018, UKB.
- Fine-tuning: eight CVDs = CD, HYP, MI, STTC, VE, SB, AFIB, GSVT.
- PTB-XL: average AUROC 0.951, range 0.916-0.986, for CD 0.986, HYP 0.916, MI 0.958, STTC 0.951, VE 0.942, fine-tuned by ECGs of 14,495 individuals (80%) and tested by 3623 (20%).
- Chapman: fine-tuned by 51,297 (80%) and tested 12,824 (20%); average AUROC 0.993, range 0.990-0.996; SB 0.996, AFIB 0.993, GSVT 0.990.
- External: CODE-15 average AUROC 0.925 for four CVDs; CPSC-2018 0.971 for four; UKB 0.807 for six.
- Comparators: HeartBEiT 0.909 PTB-XL, 0.979 Chapman, 0.896 CODE-15, 0.945 CPSC-2018, 0.778 UKB, AVG 0.901; ECG-ResNet 0.893, 0.976, 0.889, 0.939, 0.772, AVG 0.894; DCNN-LSTM 0.890, 0.972, 0.878, 0.939, 0.768, AVG 0.889.
- Heart functional phenotypes: PCC 0.649 vs HeartBEiT 0.607, ECG-ResNet 0.594, DCNN-LSTM 0.592.
- Fine-tuning data influence: 1% training set -> AUROC 0.872, HeartBEiT 0.778 (12.1% higher), ECG-ResNet 0.711 (22.6%), DCNN-LSTM 0.708 (23.2%). Ranges 1%,10%,25%,50%,100%. External CODE-15 AUROC ranging 0.833 to 0.915.
- Embeddings: 1024-dimensional EDFs.
- IG discovered 16 important EDFs (average important score >5.4 × 10−3 across 2000 samples in PTB-XL and Chapman test sets) predicting eight CVDs.
- PEI method: perturb EDF, reconstruct ECG signals, paired t-tests.
- EDF#102 ST-segment V4, MI importance 5.4e-3, STTC 6.3e-3. EDF#19 P-wave duration/amplitude V2, AFIB. EDF#945 QRS morphology R wave amplitude V5; EDF#238 and EDF#381 S wave depth V3, HYP.
- PheWAS: 16 important EDFs and 215 CVD-related phenotypes; 41,235 individuals UKB; 1387 significant associations. Phenotypes: 34 physical measures, 16 blood assays, 147 CMRI traits, 11 ECG traits, 7 disorder outcomes; Bonferroni threshold 1.5e-5 from 0.05/(16×215).
- GWAS: first 10 PCs from 1024 EDFs; 41,235 UKB; 10 PCs accounted for 85.2% variance. METAL multi-trait meta-analysis. 24 significant SNPs (P < 5e-8, r2 < 0.01 within 250kb) at 19 loci. 16 located <100kb from lead SNPs of most recent GWAS >77,898 samples for ECG traits (spatial QRS-T angle, PR interval, QT interval, P wave duration, QRS duration). 8 novel: rs77188861, rs2562829, rs13081065, rs6843082, rs9400981, rs11756440, rs67467637, rs2066626. Among 8 novel, 5 intronic in CEP85L, PRDM16, ADCY5, DLEU1, VTI1A; 2 intergenic near VGLL2 and MIR297; 1 exonic within TTN. rs6843082 P=1.2e-15 near MIR297, associated with AF (beta −0.371, P 3.4e-155), GSVT (beta −0.100, P 1.3e-8), heart failure (beta −0.075, P 2.6e-15).
- MAGMA and FUMA: 63 unique genes; MAGMA revealed 9 genes (NFIA, TTN, SAP30L, HAND1, CDKN1A, CEP85L, PLN, KLHL38, SIPA1L1); SAP30L most significant with EDFs (P = 2.8e-13).
- Methods: feature encoder convolution blocks -> tokens; quantization module -> context vectors and IDs; conformer blocks; contextual contrastive loss, MLM loss; multi-segment contrastive loss with N = 2.
- Discussion: average AUROC 0.930 (ranging from 0.807 to 0.993).
- Datasets: PTB-XL N = 18,118 European ancestry? Page 10 says PTB-XL (N = 18,118, European ancestry), Chapman (N = 10,646, Chinese ancestry), CPSC-2018 (N = 6877, Chinese ancestry), UKB (N = 41,235, mainly European ancestry). Note page 11 says PTB-XL contains 21,837 records of 18,885 individuals; Chapman 10,646 records of 10,646 individuals; CODE-15 345,779 records from 233,770 patients; CPSC-2018 9569 records of 6877 individuals.
- Embedding AUROC: ECG-LFM embeddings achieved AUROC 0.885 and 0.891 in two independent test sets derived from Chapman and CPSC-2018; HeartBEiT 0.847 and 0.849; t-SNE ARI=0.33 vs HeartBEiT 0.12.
